# Templates Overview

Use this directory for reusable file-level starting points that are meant to be copied or adapted.

## Taxonomy

- **File templates**: single reusable files in `docs/templates/`.
- **Project scaffolds**: clone-ready directory structures in `.github/template-repos/`.
- **Examples**: read-only references in `docs/examples/`.

## What belongs here

- Single-file templates for repeatable docs or planning work
- Template snippets and starter artifacts meant to be copied into active docs

## What does not belong here

- Project scaffolds with `.github/` or multi-file repository structure
- Read-only examples
- Reference implementations meant only to be inspected
- Historical archives

## Current layout

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `sprint-structure.md` | Reusable sprint planning scaffold |
| `attachment-canonical-summary.md` | Canonical summary template for attachment-heavy sessions |
| `prd-template.md` | Product requirements starting template |
| `issue-template.md` | Structured issue authoring template |

Project scaffolds previously under `docs/templates/` were moved to `.github/template-repos/`.
